passwords.heading: Passwords
passwords.reading: Reading the keyring on this computer…
passwords.couldNotRead: The keyring on this computer could not be read.
passwords.notSetUpLead: A password kept here is typed into a window or handed to a sandbox for one use, and its agent never holds it. Every change asks you here first.
passwords.passphraseLead: Choose a recovery passphrase. It unlocks the keyring whenever Windows Hello cannot, and nobody can recover it for you, so keep it somewhere safe.
passwords.unlockHello: Windows Hello or the passphrase unlocks it. While it is locked, a password shared while you're at the computer asks each time.
passwords.unlockPassphrase: The passphrase unlocks it. While it is locked, a password shared while you're at the computer asks each time.
passwords.pendingInbox: Values sent from a sandbox wait for the next unlock: {count}.
passwords.modeEachUseExplained: Each use asks you here first.
passwords.modeWhileHereExplained: Used without asking while this keyring is unlocked. Locked, each use asks.
passwords.modeCopyExplained: A copy is kept in that sandbox too, so it works with this computer off. Its guards are then the sandbox's.
passwords.name: Name, like VPN_PASSWORD
passwords.nameRule: Start with a letter or _, then letters, digits, _, . or -.
passwords.programsPlaceholder: Programs it may be typed into: FortiClient.exe, mstsc.exe
passwords.hostsPlaceholder: Sites it may go to: vpn.example.com, *.example.com
passwords.anyFieldNote: Also into fields not marked as password fields, which show what is typed.
passwords.sandboxPlaceholder: A sandbox's address or link id, or leave it empty
passwords.askpassNote: When they ask for a password, the keyring answers with the matching one, after asking you here.
passwords.hardenNote: Moves the vault under a Windows service of its own, so no program you run, an agent's commands included, can read it. One administrator prompt.
passwords.hardenedNote: On: the vault is held by the keyring's own Windows account, and no program you run can read it.
passwords.waitingSetup: Windows Hello or the keyring asks before the vault is made.
passwords.waitingAdd: The keyring asks before it keeps the password.
passwords.waitingRemove: The keyring asks before it removes the password.
passwords.waitingShare: The keyring asks before it shares the password.
passwords.waitingUnlock: Windows Hello or the passphrase unlocks it.
passwords.waitingAskpass: The keyring asks before it changes how ssh, sudo and git are answered.
passwords.waitingHarden: Windows asks for an administrator's yes.
